ZAF.note: Document is about a tax chatbot and states nothing on rules or authority for AI harms.

facts.fact: The South African Revenue Service says it has expanded its Lwazi AI Assistant across the SARS website and MobiApp to answer queries on tax reference numbers, statements of account, notices of assessment and audit or refund status.

ZAF.note: A citizen-facing support chatbot; the document states no diagnosis, score, forecast or decision output inside a sector system.
Document states no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: SARS says its Lwazi AI Assistant is designed with accessibility at its core so tax support is easier for everyone, including visually impaired users.
